$description: Design tokens, light + dark. Theme class on <html>: theme-light | theme-dark. Semantic colors in theme.<mode>.color reference theme.<mode>.palette.

md.$description: Tailwind default, referenced via fallback only

color.$description: uses color.foreground.subtle of the active theme

scale-step.$description: each stacked toast shrinks 5%, max 3 deep

entity-palette.$description: Color picker for teams/shifts; a random one is assigned to new items

available-marker.$description: inset 3px left bar on availability items

chart.$description: Chart colors: read the CSS var at runtime, fall back to these values.

contrast.$description: User-picked entity colors are adjusted in OKLCH until they meet these targets
